# Hawaii Vacation Homes

> Boutique short-term rental management company in Kīhei and South Maui, Hawaii. We manage vacation rental properties for owners, focusing on personalized service, dynamic revenue optimization, and Hawaii-rooted hospitality. Founded and operated by Matt, serving owners who want premium, hands-on management rather than mass-market property management.

Key facts:
- Based in Kīhei, Maui, Hawaii (122 Kio Loop B-2, Kīhei, HI 96753)
- Licensed Hawaii real estate brokerage (License #RB-23767), operating as Hawaii Equity Management LLC
- Serves South Maui: Kīhei, Wailea, Makena
- Specializes in condominium and single-family vacation rentals
- 100% owner retention — no owner has ever left
- 18% above-market revenue performance for managed properties in 2025
- 4.96-star average guest rating across 700+ reviews
- Full-service: dynamic pricing, guest communication, housekeeping, maintenance, owner reporting, tax filing (GET/TAT)
- No hidden fees — one flat management fee on accommodation revenue only
- Phone: 808-793-5372
- Email: aloha@hawaiivacationhomes.com
